collected: Cone Crater, Station C1, Fra Mauro Formation, Apollo 14

source.organization: NASA Astromaterials 3D (ARES Acquisition & Curation Office, Johnson Space Center)

modelParameters.camera: Hasselblad H4D-60; Lens: HC 120 II; Mega Pixels: 60; Photos: 240; Total Size: 80.5 GB
modelParameters.scale: Units: Meters; Targets: 94; Bars: 2163; Total Error: .000274 meters
modelParameters.acknowledgment: These 3D reconstructed image data were produced at the Lunar Sample Laboratory Facility for Astromaterials 3D in NASA’s Acquisition & Curation Office and were funded by NASA Planetary Data Archiving, Restoration, and Tools Program, Proposal No.: 15-PDART15_2-0041.

alsoListedAt.note: Same NASA model. Sketchfab downloads need a signed-in account, so the file was taken from NASA's bucket.

derivation.change: OBJ to glTF (obj2gltf 3), vertices welded and simplified to about 30,000 triangles with meshoptimizer (@gltf-transform/cli 4, error 0.01), colour map resized to 2048 x 2048 and stored as JPEG quality 88. Units (metres) and NASA's coordinate registration are unchanged.

use: A laboratory specimen returned to Earth, shown at its true size. It is reference material: the app never derives measurements of lunar terrain from it, and it is not evidence about a site unless an evidence pack cites it.
